query:
SELECT 
  name,
  magic_number AS magic,
  telegram_handle AS telegram,
  live_account_number AS mt5_account_number,
  live_account_server AS mt5_server,
  CONCAT('RFX - ', name, ' - ', magic_number) AS combo_output
FROM magic_numbers
ORDER BY name ASC;
